sloka: आयसम् हृदयम् नूनम् राम मातुर् असम्शयम् ।यद् देव गर्भ प्रतिमे वनम् याति न भिद्यते ॥२-४०-२३॥
transliteration: āyasam hṛdayam nūnam rāma mātur asamśayam ।yad deva garbha pratime vanam yāti na bhidyate ॥2-40-23॥

translations.english: Alas, the heart of Kausalya whose son, Rama, resembles the offspring of the gods, does not break even though he is going to the forest Undoubtedly it must be made of iron.
